messages:
Maria Santos: thinking about adding a lightweight 'preflight microbench' stage to model intake — short warmup + latency/throughput probes across quant + hw variants to catch regressions before admission. sketch: https://go/redwood/designs/preflight-microbench (WIP) :thinking:
Tom Nguyen: sounds useful. how long is 'short'? does this block admission or run async?
Maria Santos: target ~20–45s per variant. idea is async by default; only block admission for high-risk models (external origin or >10B params). can also be opt-in via intake flag.
Kevin Patel: cost concern — multiple variants × multiple hw targets = $$$. can we sample variants (run int8 + fp16 only) and skip fp32 by default?
Alice Burke: also need per-arch checks. a model that passes on p4 could regress on a7. we should record hw-id of the probe and expose it in metadata so routing + rollout can make informed choices.
Maria Santos: agreed. plan: probe on primary target hw + one fallback hw. store results in model metadata fields (as strings): `latency_p50`, `latency_p95`, `throughput_tps`, `kv_hit_ratio`. proto in doc. example run: `preflight-run --model=repo/xyz --variants=fp16,int8 --seq=2048 --samples=10`
Junaid Alam: how do we mark a probe as 'failed'? 20% p95 delta vs prior? absolute SLA? baselines drift over time so need both.
Tom Nguyen: propose two-tier thresholds: 1) absolute thresholds (eg p95 > 2s for seq=2048) that immediately flag a critical fail; 2) relative delta threshold (default 25% p95 increase) compared to last admitted profile which triggers review.
Maria Santos: implementation note — if there's no baseline (new model), run conservative gating: require manual sign-off or require extra samples to reduce noise. also add a short retry policy for transient infra blips.
Kevin Patel: automation ops suggestion: if probe fails, auto-retry up to N=2 with jitter and alternate instance; if still failing, create a ticket and attach logs + reproducible command. we should surface cost estimate per probe in the intake UI.
Alice Burke: UI/observability: add per-model preflight graph in Console, and link to the raw bench csv. telemetry should include probe hw, kernel selection, batch sizes used. also include a tiny flamegraph capture when latency spikes.
Maria Santos: next steps: I'll update the design doc with a concrete state machine (queued -> running -> success/warn/fail -> retry/escalate) and a proto for metadata. cc @Tom @Kevin for review; I can stub the intake flag and a minimal async task in the intake service. :+1:
